examples.question_text: A credit card has no interest-free period and charges $18.25\%$ p.a. compounded daily, including the purchase and statement dates. The only purchases are $\$270$ on $19$ May and $\$130$ on $25$ May. There is no opening balance, repayment or fee. Find the closing balance on $31$ May, the interest charged and a minimum payment of $2\%$ of the closing balance. Give money answers to the nearest cent.
examples.solution_text:
$r=\dfrac{0.1825}{365}=0.0005$.
First purchase: $n=31-19+1=13$ days.
$FV=270(1.0005)^{13}$.
Second purchase: $n=31-25+1=7$ days.
$FV=130(1.0005)^7$.
Closing balance $=270(1.0005)^{13}+130(1.0005)^7$.
Closing balance $\approx\$402.22$.
Interest $=402.22-270-130$.
Interest $=\$2.22$.
Minimum payment $=0.02\times402.22$.
Minimum payment $\approx\$8.04$.

examples.question_text: A card has no interest-free period and charges $14.6\%$ p.a. compounded daily, including purchase and statement dates. The only purchases are $\$350$ on $8$ April and $\$120$ on $23$ April; the statement date is $30$ April. There is no opening balance, repayment or fee. Find (a) the closing balance, (b) the interest charged and (c) a minimum payment of $2.5\%$ of the closing balance. Give money answers to the nearest cent.
examples.solution_text:
$r=0.146\div365=0.0004$.
The purchases accrue interest for $30-8+1=23$ days and $30-23+1=8$ days.
(a) Closing balance $=350(1.0004)^{23}+120(1.0004)^8\approx\$473.62$. Keep both calculator values unrounded when adding.
(b) Interest $=350(1.0004)^{23}+120(1.0004)^8-470\approx\$3.62$.
(c) Minimum payment $=0.025(473.62)\approx\$11.84$. It is a payment towards the balance, not the interest charge.

examples.question_text: A card charges $14.6\%$ p.a. compounded daily, including purchase and statement dates. The only purchases are $\$200$ on $29$ April and $\$100$ on $30$ April. There is no opening balance or fee. Interest is charged through $30$ April, then a repayment of $\$150$ is made. Find the amount owing immediately after the repayment, to the nearest cent.
examples.solution_text:
$r=\dfrac{0.146}{365}=0.0004$.
First purchase: $n=30-29+1=2$ days.
$FV=200(1.0004)^2=200.160032$.
Second purchase: $n=30-30+1=1$ day.
$FV=100(1.0004)=100.04$.
Balance before repayment $=200.160032+100.04$.
Balance before repayment $=300.200032$.
Amount owing $=300.200032-150$.
Amount owing $\approx\$150.20$.

examples.question_text: A card charges $18.25\%$ p.a. compounded daily, including purchase and statement dates. The only purchases are $\$80$ on $29$ June and $\$120$ on $30$ June. There is no opening balance, repayment or fee. The minimum payment is $5\%$ of the closing balance on $30$ June or $\$25$, whichever is greater. Find the minimum payment, to the nearest cent.
examples.solution_text:
$r=\dfrac{0.1825}{365}=0.0005$.
First purchase: $n=30-29+1=2$ days.
$FV=80(1.0005)^2=80.08002$.
Second purchase: $n=30-30+1=1$ day.
$FV=120(1.0005)=120.06$.
Closing balance $=80.08002+120.06$.
Closing balance $\approx\$200.14$.
$5\%$ of closing balance $=0.05\times200.14$.
$5\%$ of closing balance $\approx\$10.01$.
Since $\$25>\$10.01$, the minimum payment is $\$25$.

examples.question_text: A credit card statement for May shows two purchases: a phone for $\$300$ on $8$ May and clothes for $\$200$ on $25$ May. There is no opening balance, repayment or fee. Interest at $14.6\%$ p.a. is compounded daily. The statement specifies that interest on the phone is charged from $20$ May to $31$ May, including both dates, and interest on the clothes is charged from $25$ May to $31$ May, including both dates. Find the closing balance on $31$ May, the interest charged and the minimum payment of $3\%$ of the closing balance. Also find the interest as a percentage of the full amount owing, to two decimal places. Give money answers to the nearest cent.

A credit card balance of $\$800$ attracts interest compounded daily at $0.05\%$ for $2$ days. There are no purchases, repayments or fees during this period. Find the final balance and the interest charged, each to the nearest cent.

A credit card offers a $55$-day interest-free period on purchases only when the purchase is repaid in full within that period. Otherwise, interest is charged from the purchase date. A purchase of $\$500$ remains unpaid after $60$ charged days. The rate is $14.6\%$ p.a., compounded daily. There are no other purchases, repayments or fees. Write the daily interest rate as a fraction and a decimal, then find the amount owing and interest charged, each to the nearest cent.
examples.solution_text:
The purchase was not repaid within the interest-free period, so all $60$ days are charged.
$r=\dfrac{0.146}{365}=0.0004$.
$\begin{aligned}FV&=PV(1+r)^n\\FV&=500(1.0004)^{60}\end{aligned}$
Amount owing $\approx\$512.14$.
Interest $=500(1.0004)^{60}-500$.
Interest charged $\approx\$12.14$.
